claude.sample_unit: antibiotic susceptibility classifications from urine cultures
models_evaluated: machine learning algorithms predicting antibiotic susceptibility

links.outcome: Algorithm AUC in geographically distant cohort before vs after training on local antibiogram
links.effect: Without additional training AUC 0.69-0.87; when trained on the distant hospital's antibiogram, accuracy improved (AUC 0.70-0.93).
links.quote: When the algorithms were trained on the antibiogram from the geographically-distant hospital, the accuracy improved (AUC 0.70-0.93).

links.outcome: Adequacy of empiric oral antibiotic coverage, algorithm-suggested vs clinician-prescribed
links.effect: The drug agent suggested by the algorithms more frequently resulted in adequate empiric coverage than clinician prescriptions for oral antibiotics.
links.quote: When algorithms' performances were tested against clinicians in a contemporary cohort for the empiric prescription of oral antibiotics, the drug agent suggested by the algorithms more frequently resulted in adequate empiric coverage.

links.effect: Geographically distant external validation remained accurate without additional training: AUC 0.69-0.87.
links.quote: In external validation in a geographically-distant cohort, the algorithms remained accurate even without additional training on this group (AUC 0.69-0.87).

links.effect: Algorithm-suggested oral antibiotics more frequently resulted in adequate empiric coverage; no numeric percentage reported.
links.quote: When algorithms' performances were tested against clinicians in a contemporary cohort for the empiric prescription of oral antibiotics, the drug agent suggested by the algorithms more frequently resulted in adequate empiric coverage.

links.effect: Training on the geographically distant hospital antibiogram improved accuracy: AUC 0.70-0.93.
links.quote: When the algorithms were trained on the antibiogram from the geographically-distant hospital, the accuracy improved (AUC 0.70-0.93).

links.outcome: algorithm accuracy after local antibiogram training
links.effect: accuracy improved to AUC 0.70-0.93 compared to AUC 0.69-0.87 without additional training
links.quote: When the algorithms were trained on the antibiogram from the geographically-distant hospital, the accuracy improved (AUC 0.70-0.93).

screen.practice: local retraining/recalibration on local antibiogram before deployment
screen.reason: The study conducts external validation across hospital systems and evaluates the impact of retraining on local hospital antibiogram data versus zero-shot transfer, in addition to comparing suggested empiric therapy against clinician practice.

primary.practice: local retraining or fine-tuning on local hospital data
